scripts.build: npm run validators:generate && vite build && vite build --mode fixture
scripts.format: prettier --write src dev/*.ts dev/*.html tests/frontend tests/e2e contracts *.json *.ts *.js .github/workflows/*.yml --ignore-path .gitignore
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src dev/*.ts dev/*.html tests/frontend tests/e2e contracts *.json *.ts *.js .github/workflows/*.yml --ignore-path .gitignore
scripts.contracts:generate: node --input-type=module -e 'import {compileFromFile} from "json-schema-to-typescript"; import {writeFile} from "node:fs/promises"; for (const [schemas, output] of [[["card-config"], "src/config/types.ts"], [["integration-config"], "src/config/integration-types.ts"], [["command", "event", "info"], "src/data/types.ts"], [["assets"], "src/data/asset-types.ts"]]) { let types = ""; for (const schema of schemas) types += await compileFromFile("contracts/" + schema + ".schema.json", {additionalProperties:false, declareExternallyReferenced:true, maxItems:-1}); await writeFile(output, types); }' && prettier --write src/config/types.ts src/config/integration-types.ts src/data/types.ts src/data/asset-types.ts
